admin.title: Floating Ads
admin.description: Manage defaults, ad images, and date/time reservations in one screen.
admin.edit_loaded: Loaded the selected ad into the form.
admin.image_url_hint: Enter a public image URL (https://... or /storage/...).
admin.image_file_hint: Choose a jpg, png, gif, or webp file (max 10MB).
admin.source_hint: Choose either file upload or an image URL. Only one applies.
admin.settings_hint: These values apply when reservations are off, and as defaults for new reservation rows.
admin.offset_px_hint: Left/right: from the content box edge. Positive = outward into the side margin, negative = inward over the content. Top/bottom: from the viewport edge (negative = off-screen direction).
admin.vertical_align_hint: Applies to left/right ads. Top/bottom positions stay horizontally centered on the viewport.
admin.vertical_offset_px_hint: Top: px from the viewport top (negative = up). Bottom: px from the viewport bottom (negative = down). Middle: nudge from center (positive = down, negative = up).
admin.schedules_enabled_hint: When on, only the matching reservation below is applied. If none match, ads are hidden.
admin.schedules_hint: Add multiple windows. The first matching On row from the top wins. Turn a row off to skip it. All days on or empty means every day.
admin.item_ids_hint: Leave empty to show all currently enabled ads.
admin.row_settings_hint: Override position, size, and carousel options for this window only.

stats.title: Floating ad stats
stats.description: Impressions and clicks by ad, by page, and by ad × page.
stats.hint: Impressions are counted once per ad per page per session. Clicks are counted every time.
stats.empty: No stats in this range yet. Counts appear after ads are shown.
